title: Tramway notice with gaps
instruction: The notice below has numbered gaps written as [gap N]. Fill each gap where the notice itself settles what belongs there. Where it does not, write [unknown] in the gap's place. Output only the completed notice, nothing else.
source: Line 4 of the Varnholm tramway runs from Kestrel Quay to the university, with 14 stops. Service begins at 05:40 from Kestrel Quay and the full journey is timetabled at 31 minutes, so the first tram reaches the university at [gap 1]. Trams run every 7 minutes in the peak and every [gap 2] minutes off-peak. The fleet of 22 cars was built by [gap 3] between 2011 and [gap 4]; the line's depot is at [gap 5], the [gap 6]th stop. On Sundays the first departure is at 07:00 and the journey time is unchanged, so the first Sunday tram reaches the university at [gap 7].
